info.title: Showpass Organizer Reports API
info.description: Read saved report configurations, cash-out receipts, invoice totals and payout summaries.

get.description: Reads saved report configuration for the organization bound to the key. Requires Manage Reports or All Access. Configurations can include email recipients. List results default to most recently updated first, then descending ID.

parameters.name: ordering
parameters.description: Use id or -id to order by report ID.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page requests are independent and may reflect intervening edits.

parameters.description: Search by saved report name.

get.description: Requires a key bound to the organization and Administer Transactions, Box Office Sales, or All Access. Provide an increasing date range of at most 31 days, starting on or after January 1, 2000. Restricted employees need View Transaction Totals or Manage Transactions, depending on organization configuration. When totals are hidden, the server returns HTTP 200 with an empty body. Totals can change between requests.

get.description: Requires Administer Transactions or All Access in the key organization. The transaction ID must identify a visible settlement invoice. Returns the available financial summary rows for that payout. Use a GET request without a body for the default summary. Existing clients that send a JSON GET body can supply filtered_column_ids there as an array of column IDs.
